2026-11-29.title: 10 km | Easy pace
2026-11-29.detail:
Easy pace for distance.
This is exactly as it says, it should feel very easy, almost too easy. These runs are used as recovery runs or pre/post a big race or challenge.

2026-11-30.title: Quad-Focused Strength & Power
2026-11-30.detail:
CLICK ON VIDEO TAB FOR DEMONSTRATION OF MOVEMENT.
Warm-Up:
• A Skips – 2 x 30 seconds
• High Knees – 2 x 30 seconds
• World's Greatest Stretch – 3 reps per side
Main Workout:
1. Cyclist Squat– 4 x 10 reps (weighted if possible)
2. FFE Split Squat– 3 x 10 reps per leg
3. Lunge Pulse– 3 x 12 reps per leg
4. Squat Jumps– 3 x 15 reps (explosive movement for power)
5. Reverse Lunge(TRX or bodyweight) – 3 x 10 reps per leg
Core Finisher:
• Plank Jacks – 3 x 20 seconds
• Side Plank (easy or hard) – 2 x 20 seconds per side
Cool Down:
• Couch Stretch – 30 seconds per leg
• Soleus Stretch – 30 seconds per side
• Foam Roll Quads

2026-12-01.title: Ankle/Calf/Achilles Strengthening
2026-12-01.detail:
Calf raises both legs x 50
Calf raises each leg x 20
Jump on the spot x 50
Jump on the spot each leg x 20
Jump left/right x 20 each leg
Jump forward/backwards x 20 each leg
Squat x 20
Lunge x 10 each leg
Roll calfs

2026-12-01.detail: 1 km @ Easy pace | INTERVALS: 1 min @ full effort, 1 min @ easy pace and repeat for distance | 1 km @ Easy pace

2026-12-02.title: Functional Core
2026-12-02.detail:
CLICK ON VIDEO TAB FOR DEMONSTRATION OF MOVEMENT.
•Warm-Up:
• World's Greatest Stretch – 4 per side, hold 10 seconds per position
• Reverse Lunge with Knee Drive – 2 x 10 per leg
•Main Set:
1. Side Plank Hard (do Side Plank Easy if needed) – 2 x 45 seconds per side
2. Plank – 3 x 45-second hold
3. Dumbbell Under Core Move – 3 x 12 (can use any weight if you don't have a dumbbell)
4. Romanian Deadlift – 3 x 10 (dumbbells or bodyweight)
•Cool-Down:
• Soleus Stretch – Hold 30 seconds per leg
• Scorpion Stretch – 10 slow reps (5 per side)

2026-12-03.title: 6 km | Hill Sprint Reps (Up)
2026-12-03.detail: 1 km @ Easy pace to hill | 4 km: Hills | 1 km @ Easy pace. Run at maximum effort up the hill and jog slowly or walk back down. Take up to 30 seconds rest before going again. You should use a hill that gives you approx 30-45 secs of climbing. Vary the gradient of hill each time if you can. However, don't use hills that are too steep.

2026-12-06.title: 22 km | Ultra pace
2026-12-06.detail:
Ultra pace (preferably on trails - walk the hills)
This is a pace to aim for during long runs when training for your ultra. This pace is will seem slow as it basically takes into account the fact that you will be both running and walking. It's essentially a 'keep moving' pace and is more aimed at stopping you going too fast than anything else.
